description: Prepare Budget Summary amounts once by year, category and line, including category totals. Budget performs one exact XMATCH and retrieves the requested scalar with INDEX through named column ranges.

summary.before:
=LET(
  expenses, S_ALL_EXPENSES,
  positions, SEQUENCE(ROWS(expenses)),
  category_column, CHOOSECOLS(expenses, MATCH("Budget Category", HEADER_ROW(expenses), 0)),
  source, FILTER(expenses, ARRAYFORMULA((category_column<>"")+(positions=2))),
  years, COL_VALUES(source, "Year"),
  categories, COL_VALUES(source, "Budget Category"),
  lines, ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(COL_VALUES(source, "Budget Line")))),
  bases, COL_VALUES(source, "Basis"),
  costs, COL_VALUES(source, "Cost"),
  contingency, COL_VALUES(source, "Contingency"),
  fields, TOCOL(HSTACK(years, categories, lines, bases, costs, contingency)),
  errors, ARRAYFORMULA(ISERROR(fields)),
  IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(errors)))>0, INDEX(fields, MATCH(TRUE, errors, 0)),
    IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA((categories<>"")*(NOT(ISNUMBER(costs))+NOT(ISNUMBER(contingency)))))>0, NA(),
      QUERY(HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(categories="", 0, years)), categories, lines, bases,
        ARRAYFORMULA(IF(categories="", 0, costs)), ARRAYFORMULA(IF(categories="", 0, contingency))),
        "select Col1,Col2,Col3,Col4,sum(Col5),sum(Col6) group by Col1,Col2,Col3,Col4 label Col1 'Year',Col2 'Budget Category',Col3 'Budget Line',Col4 'Basis',sum(Col5) 'Cost',sum(Col6) 'Contingency'", 0)
    )
  )
)
summary.after:
=LET(
  expenses, S_ALL_EXPENSES,
  positions, SEQUENCE(ROWS(expenses)),
  category_column, CHOOSECOLS(expenses, MATCH("Budget Category", HEADER_ROW(expenses), 0)),
  source, FILTER(expenses, ARRAYFORMULA((category_column<>"")+(positions=2))),
  years, COL_VALUES(source, "Year"),
  categories, ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(COL_VALUES(source, "Budget Category"))),
  lines, ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(COL_VALUES(source, "Budget Line")))),
  bases, COL_VALUES(source, "Basis"),
  costs, COL_VALUES(source, "Cost"),
  contingency, COL_VALUES(source, "Contingency"),
  titles, {"Year","Budget Category","Budget Line","Past Expenses","Future Expenses","Total Expenses","Past Contingency","Future Contingency","Contingency","Lookup Key"},
  fields, TOCOL(HSTACK(years, categories, lines, bases, costs, contingency)),
  errors, ARRAYFORMULA(ISERROR(fields)),
  IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(errors)))>0, INDEX(fields, MATCH(TRUE, errors, 0)),
    IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA((categories<>"")*(NOT(ISNUMBER(costs))+NOT(ISNUMBER(contingency))+((bases<>"Actual")*(bases<>"Planned")))))>0, NA(),
      IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(categories<>"")))=0, titles,
        LET(
          detail, DATA_ROWS(QUERY(
            HSTACK(years, categories, lines,
              ARRAYFORMULA(IF(bases="Actual", costs, 0)),
              ARRAYFORMULA(IF(bases="Planned", costs, 0)),
              ARRAYFORMULA(IF(bases="Actual", contingency, 0)),
              ARRAYFORMULA(IF(bases="Planned", contingency, 0))),
            "select Col1,Col2,Col3,sum(Col4),sum(Col5),sum(Col6),sum(Col7) where Col2 is not null group by Col1,Col2,Col3", 0)),
          totals, DATA_ROWS(QUERY(detail,
            "select Col1,Col2,sum(Col4),sum(Col5),sum(Col6),sum(Col7) group by Col1,Col2", 0)),
          category_rows, HSTACK(CHOOSECOLS(totals, 1, 2),
            ARRAYFORMULA(IF(CHOOSECOLS(totals, 2)<>"", "", "")), CHOOSECOLS(totals, 3, 4, 5, 6)),
          combined, VSTACK(detail, category_rows),
          keep_rows, VSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(CHOOSECOLS(detail, 3)<>""), ARRAYFORMULA(CHOOSECOLS(category_rows, 2)<>"")),
          summary, SORT(FILTER(combined, keep_rows), 1, TRUE, 2, TRUE, 3, TRUE),
          summary_years, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 1),
          summary_categories, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 2),
          summary_lines, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 3),
          past, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 4),
          future, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 5),
          past_contingency, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 6),
          future_contingency, CHOOSECOLS(summary, 7),
          keys, ARRAYFORMULA(summary_years&"|"&LEN(summary_categories)&":"&summary_categories&"|"&summary_lines),
          VSTACK(titles, HSTACK(summary_years, summary_categories, summary_lines,
            past, future, ARRAYFORMULA(past+future), past_contingency, future_contingency,
            ARRAYFORMULA(past_contingency+future_contingency), keys))
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
summary.categoryTotalConvention: Blank Budget Line means the total for the year/category.

namedFunction.name: BUDGET_ITEMS_SUM
namedFunction.before:
=LET(
  category, BUDGET_VALUE("_category"),
  budget_year, BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
  budget_line, LOWER(TRIM(BUDGET_VALUE("budget line"))),
  line_key, IF(budget_line="out loans disbursements", "out loan disbursements", budget_line),
  categories, COL_VALUES(BUDGET_SUMMARY, "Budget Category"),
  lines, COL_VALUES(BUDGET_SUMMARY, "Budget Line"),
  years, COL_VALUES(BUDGET_SUMMARY, "Year"),
  bases, COL_VALUES(BUDGET_SUMMARY, "Basis"),
  amounts, COL_VALUES(BUDGET_SUMMARY, amount_column),
  matches, ARRAYFORMULA((categories=category)*(years=budget_year)*
    IF(line_key="", 1, LOWER(TRIM(lines))=line_key)*
    IF(basis="", 1, bases=basis)),
  IF(SUM(matches)=0, 0, SUM(FILTER(amounts, matches)))
)
namedFunction.after:
=IF(ISERROR(BUDGET_SUMMARY_STATUS), BUDGET_SUMMARY_STATUS,
  LET(
    category, LOWER(BUDGET_VALUE("_category")),
    budget_year, BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
    budget_line, LOWER(TRIM(BUDGET_VALUE("budget line"))),
    line_key, IF(budget_line="out loans disbursements", "out loan disbursements", budget_line),
    key, budget_year&"|"&LEN(category)&":"&category&"|"&line_key,
    lookup_row, IFNA(XMATCH(key, BUDGET_SUMMARY_KEYS, 0), 0),
    lookup_amount, LAMBDA(amounts, IF(lookup_row=0, 0, INDEX(amounts, lookup_row))),
    SWITCH(amount_column,
      "Cost", SWITCH(basis,
        "Actual", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_PAST),
        "Planned", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_FUTURE),
        "", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_COST),
        0),
      "Contingency", SWITCH(basis,
        "Actual", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_PAST_CONTINGENCY),
        "Planned", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_FUTURE_CONTINGENCY),
        "", lookup_amount(BUDGET_SUMMARY_CONTINGENCY),
        0),
      NA())
  )
)
